message.content:
Here’s a quick reference for the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means the holiday falls on a weekday, giving you a weekend plus the holiday day.)

| Holiday | Date 2023 | Long‑Weekend Days |
|---------|-----------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Jan 1–3 (Sun‑Mon‑Tue) |
| Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB, ON, PE) | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18–20 (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | Apr 7–9 (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | May 20–22 (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Sat) | Jul 1–3 (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | Sep 2–4 (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | Oct 7–9 (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Mon) | Nov 9–11 (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Mon) | Dec 23–25 (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tue) | Dec 24–26 (Sat‑Sun‑Tue) |

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., Family Day isn’t observed in all provinces), let me know and I can adjust the list accordingly!
